question: Is the production-path harness with only MessagingApiClient.getProfile stubbed sufficient for this internal cache-bound invariant, or must the PR demonstrate the behavior in a live LINE gateway?
rationale: Repository policy treats mock-backed evidence as insufficient for external PRs, but the changed invariant is entirely local and deterministic, making sustained live LINE proof disproportionately difficult without improving confidence in the cache algorithm.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the detailed production-path harness, focused regressions, and green CI because the external LINE response does not affect Map eviction semantics.

options.title: Require live LINE evidence
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted gateway run or runtime log demonstrates bounded profile-cache behavior under real LINE traffic.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR open without override until maintainers have capacity or infrastructure for a live LINE validation run.
